title: Kerala Circuit: Kochi → Munnar → Athirapally → Alappuzha → Kumarakom

Athirapally Falls.desc: The Athirapally Falls, Wayanad, #Alleppey, Kovalam are some of the Monsoon recommendations for you. The blissful sight of the near 100 feet high shimmering Athirapally falls gushing down to the bottom is no less than mesmerizing.

Alappuzha.desc: Alappuzha or Alleppey is a municipality and town on the Laccadive Sea in the southern Indian state of Kerala. It is the district headquarters of the Alappuzha District, and is located about 130 km (80.8 mi) north of the state capital Thiruvananthapur

Kumarakom.desc: Kumarakom is a tourism destination near the city of Kottayam in Kerala, India. It is near the Vembanad Lake, the largest lake in the state of Kerala. In January 2023 The New York Times mentioned Kumarakom's backwater tourism.
